summary: A unit test runs a small piece of code with known inputs and checks the result. Python's unittest module is in the standard library, so you can test without installing anything.
notes: Test methods must start with test_. unittest finds and runs them by that name.
test_boundaries checks 89, 90, 69, and 70, because off-by-one mistakes happen at cutoffs.
with self.assertRaises(ValueError): passes only if the block raises ValueError.
pitfall: Naming a method check_boundaries instead of test_boundaries means unittest never runs it, and the report shows fewer tests with no error.
